sections.heading: What is trending: “autógyártás”
paragraphs: “autógyártás” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for HU (snapshot taken 2026-11-14T10:28:28+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 200 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Autopro.hu, Autoszektor, Mobilissimo.hu. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Győrtől Debrecenig érezhető lehet az AI újabb mellékhatása – veszélyben az autógyártás” — Autoszektor
“Az AI-boom a SMIC-et is felpörgette: 123%-kal ugrott a profit” — Mobilissimo.hu
“Az MI-boom miatt kerülhet ismét bajba az autóipar” — Autopro.hu

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sat, 14 Nov 2026 02:00:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-14T10:28:28+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-14T10:28:32+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
